en.headline: InnoCarnival 2026 continues at Science Park through 1 November
en.dek: The nine-day free event organised by the Innovation and Technology Commission features aerospace exhibits, workshops and interactive games under the theme Lead with I&T Dream to Fly High.
body: InnoCarnival 2026 is under way at the Hong Kong Science Park in Sha Tin and runs until 1 November, the Innovation and Technology Commission said.

Organised by the commission, the event carries the theme Lead with I&T Dream to Fly High and includes an aerospace thematic zone showing research projects from local universities and their contributions to national space missions.

Opening hours are 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturdays and Sundays, and 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays. All activities are free, with around 150 workshops and interactive games available. Visitors can register online in advance for some sessions, with limited on-site places also held.
Financial Secretary Paul Chan opened the carnival on Saturday, noting Hong Kong’s research strengths and the role of the Northern Metropolis in linking education, technology and industry.

zh.headline: 創新科技嘉年華2026科學園進行中 至11月1日
zh.dek: 創新科技署主辦的九日免費活動以「創科領航 夢想高飛」為主題，設航天專區、工作坊及互動遊戲。
body: 創新科技署表示，創新科技嘉年華2026正在沙田香港科學園舉行，活動至11月1日結束。
活動以「創科領航 夢想高飛」為主題，特設航天專區，展示本地大學科研項目及對國家航天任務的貢獻。
開放時間為星期六及日上午10時至下午6時，平日上午10時至下午5時。所有活動免費，約有150場工作坊及互動遊戲。部分場次可網上預先報名，亦預留少量即場名額。
財政司司長陳茂波周六主持開幕，提到香港的科研實力及北部都會區在教育、科技與產業連結中的角色。
